events.title: White Rabbit Collection Exhibition
events.description: HOTA Gallery presents a major exhibition of contemporary Chinese art from the White Rabbit Collection, featuring large-scale installations, video, and sculpture exploring themes of identity, history, and transformation.

events.title: Gold Coast Pride Month Events
events.description: A month-long celebration of LGBTQIA+ culture featuring over 20 community-oriented events across Gold Coast, including socials, picnics, and performances, culminating in Pride Fair Day.

events.title: NaturallyGC Botanical Watercolour Painting Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop combining art and nature, focusing on botanical watercolour painting. Part of the City of Gold Coast's NaturallyGC program, designed to connect people with the local natural environment.
